## Overview

`LineDrawOperations.hpp` provides Qt-free helpers for committing line geometry from Media Viewer pen tools.

## API

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `mediaCoordsToLineDataCoords` | Convert canvas click coordinates into a target `LineData` key's coordinate system |
| `commitNewLineAtTime` | `addAtTime` wrapper that returns the new `EntityId` |
| `entityExistsAtTime` | Verify a selected entity is present on the current frame before append/delete |

## Usage

`MediaLine_Widget` calls `commitNewLineAtTime` when the Pen tool target is **New line · {key}**. Draw Across All Frames continues to use its own batch apply path in the properties panel.
